rotation_policy: Every combined class has one actual upper rotating action and one actual lower rotating action. No rotational landings are added. Stages4/5 intentionally reuse an earlier genuine lower rotation drill instead of labeling lateral/chamber-only work rotation.

default_environment: Three separate10m lanes. Throws require verified light grippable ball, permitted impact surface, full flight/rebound/roll containment and lateral clearance. No throwing wall, low rebound, band-anchor fitness, landmine minimum load, staffing or feeder skill assumed. Rest 25 s between efforts, then 90 s before E6.

upperPrimary.combinedCue: Secure the landmine and qualify the bar, grip and minimum load. Hold the sleeve or suitable grip in both hands with elbows softly bent. sourceExerciseRecord.execution: Use both hands and softly bent elbows. Turn feet/hips with a modest side-to-side arc; keep ribs over pelvis. One one-way traverse is one rep and the reverse is the next rep; six alternating traverses contain three per direction. Take about 2 seconds per traverse and settle briefly at the endpoint.
sourceExerciseRecord.regress: Reduce arc/load if the knee twists, trunk leans or endpoint runs away.
sourceExerciseRecord.novelty: Permitted recurring strength lift; see this class's progression decision.

upperPrimary.job: Load the turning arc and endpoint braking after arrival. Use both hands and softly bent elbows. Turn feet/hips with a modest side-to-side arc; keep ribs over pelvis. One one-way traverse is one rep and the reverse is the next rep; six alternating traverses contain three per direction. Take about 2 seconds per traverse and settle briefly at the endpoint. Reduce arc/load if the knee twists, trunk leans or endpoint runs away.
upperPrimary.cue: A one-way traverse is one rep; the return is the next counted rep. Use a modest arc, feet and pelvis turning freely with the load. Secure landmine/bar/grip and qualify minimum load. Same-dose standing two-hand band rotation is a proposed replacement if the bar is unsuitable; log it as changed setup.
upperPrimary.selectionStatus: Recommendation for root to curate against the four force-primary jobs and cumulative week workload; no plain row/floor press selected as rotation support.
upperPrimary.combinedCue: Secure the landmine and qualify the bar, grip and minimum load. Hold the sleeve or suitable grip in both hands with elbows softly bent. Turn the feet and hips with a modest side-to-side loaded arc while keeping ribs over pelvis. Each one-way traverse is one rep; the return is the next counted rep. Take about 2 seconds per traverse and settle briefly at each endpoint. Avoid trunk lean, a trapped knee or an uncontrolled finish.
upperPrimary.combinedJob: Load the turning arc and controlled endpoints that transmit lower-body force into the selected upper rotational action.
upperPrimary.combinedReplacement: Reduce the load or arc for loss of alignment. If a secured, manageable landmine setup cannot be qualified, use a standing two-hand band rotation with a verified side anchor and the same one-way traverse counting instead; log the changed setup. Apply this change only to the same remaining combined dose and recovery; it replaces the original execution and adds no extra task or make-up attempts.

lowerPrimary.selectionStatus: Recommendation for root to curate against the four force-primary jobs and cumulative week workload; no plain row/floor press selected as rotation support.
lowerPrimary.combinedCue: Hold a suitable dumbbell at the chest in a comfortable wide stance. Sit toward the working hip as the other leg lengthens, keeping the loaded foot supported and the knee following the toes. Return to centre under control. Use about 2 seconds lowering, 1 second lifting and 1 second organising the next rep. Depth is individually qualified; do not force a deep groin stretch or turn on a fixed knee.
lowerPrimary.combinedJob: Supply a substantial lateral knee-and-hip compound, strengthening weight acceptance and return over the stance leg that supports the selected lower rotational action.
lowerPrimary.combinedReplacement: Use a shallower controlled Cossack range and adjust the dumbbell load for knee or pelvic-position faults. Stop for groin pain or inability to qualify a challenging controlled range; do not add a second movement. Apply this change only to the same remaining combined dose and recovery; it replaces the original execution and adds no extra task or make-up attempts.

lowerPrimary.combinedCue: Sit on a stable bench with thighs supported and hips and knees near 90 degrees. Fit a secure loop around the lower shins. Reduce arc/load if the knee twists, trunk leans or endpoint runs away.
upperPrimary.cue: A one-way traverse is one rep; the return is the next counted rep. Use a modest arc, feet and pelvis turning freely with the load. Secure landmine/bar/grip and qualify minimum load. Same-dose standing two-hand band rotation is a proposed replacement if the bar is unsuitable; log it as changed setup.
upperPrimary.selectionStatus: Recommendation for root to curate against the four force-primary jobs and cumulative week workload; no plain row/floor press selected as rotation support.
upperPrimary.combinedCue: Secure the landmine and qualify the bar, grip and minimum load. Hold the sleeve or suitable grip in both hands with elbows softly bent. Turn the feet and hips with a modest side-to-side loaded arc while keeping ribs over pelvis. Each one-way traverse is one rep; the return is the next counted rep. Take about 2 seconds per traverse and settle briefly at each endpoint. Avoid trunk lean, a trapped knee or an uncontrolled finish.
upperPrimary.combinedJob: Load the turning arc and controlled endpoints that transmit lower-body force into the selected upper rotational action.
upperPrimary.combinedReplacement: Reduce the load or arc for loss of alignment. sourceExerciseRecord.job_execution: 1 × 8 per leg/side = 16 working reps. Sit on a stable bench, hips/knees near 90°, thighs supported. A loop around the lower shins resists the working foot moving outward, lightly clear of the floor, while that knee stays in place; the other foot is firmly planted. 2 s outward rotation, 2 s controlled return. Rest 60 s between sides, then 60 s. Preserve direct hip-turn strength with one controlled round after the precision drills. Use modest rotation, enough resistance for 2–3 clean RIR, and a quiet knee/pelvis. If a secure loop cannot be fitted, use instead self-resisted seated hip internal rotation: opposite hand resisting the outside of the lower shin, same reps/tempo. Log manual resistance as less reproducible.

lowerPrimary.cue: Seated direct hip internal rotation: thigh supported, knee stays in place, foot moves outward a small comfortable distance. 2 seconds out and 2 seconds return. lowerPrimary.combinedCue: Sit on a stable bench with thighs supported and hips and knees near 90 degrees. Fit a secure loop around the lower shins. Keep the other foot planted while the working foot moves a short distance outward, lightly clear of the floor, through hip internal rotation. Keep that knee and the pelvis still. Take 2 seconds outward and 2 seconds returning; do not force end range or twist the knee or ankle.
lowerPrimary.combinedJob: Load controlled internal-rotation torque directly at the hip, complementing the larger leg push used to organise the selected grounded lower turn.
lowerPrimary.combinedReplacement: Reduce range or band tension for knee, ankle or pelvic movement. sourceExerciseRecord.job_execution: 1 × 8 per leg/side = 16 working reps. Sit on a stable bench, hips/knees near 90°, thighs supported. A loop around the lower shins resists the working foot moving outward, lightly clear of the floor, while that knee stays in place; the other foot is firmly planted. 2 s outward rotation, 2 s controlled return. lowerPrimary.combinedCue: Sit on a stable bench with thighs supported and hips and knees near 90 degrees. Fit a secure loop around the lower shins. Keep the other foot planted while the working foot moves a short distance outward, lightly clear of the floor, through hip internal rotation. Keep that knee and the pelvis still. Take 2 seconds outward and 2 seconds returning; do not force end range or twist the knee or ankle.
lowerPrimary.combinedJob: Load controlled internal-rotation torque directly at the hip, complementing the larger leg push used to organise the selected grounded lower turn.
lowerPrimary.combinedReplacement: Reduce range or band tension for knee, ankle or pelvic movement. If the loop cannot be fitted securely, use self-resisted seated hip internal rotation with the opposite hand resisting the outside of the lower shin instead; manual resistance is a changed and less reproducible load. Apply this change only to the same remaining combined dose and recovery; it replaces the original execution and adds no extra task or make-up attempts.
